    Recursive construction of the standard mesh realization #

    The vertices are processed in an increasing enumeration of the chosen directed order. At one target, the incoming occurrence representatives are replaced by the components of a right almost-split sink. The nonprojective sink is first normalized so that its paired source composite vanishes; the projective sink is the transported radical inclusion.
